content: Spatial language grounding SOTA: SpatialVLA (arxiv 2501.15830) adds Ego3D Position Encoding (depth model → 3D coords per pixel, added to 2D VLM features) + Adaptive Action Grids (discretized continuous actions spatially). Trained on 1.1M real-world episodes. Zero-shot cross-robot control. Evaluated on 16 real tasks and 48 simulation setups. RoboPoint: instruction-tuned VLM that predicts image-space affordance points for spatial relations, outperforms GPT-4o by 20%. 3D-VLA: 3D world model backbone for manipulation. Key insight: explicit 3D spatial encoding in VLA significantly improves manipulation success for spatially-specified tasks.
